import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int N, M;
    static long[] probability = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[] probability2 = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[][] probs = new long[10][10];
    static int[] reverse_index = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] reverse_index2 = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] corr = new int[25];

    static long mod_pow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void enumerate_subsets(int step, List<Integer> current, long prob) {
        if (step == M) {
            int next_id = 0, mask = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) != M) continue;
                List<Integer> selected = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) selected.add(i);
                }
                Collections.sort(selected);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int idx = 0; idx < M; idx++) {
                        if ((((current.get(idx) >> selected.get(idx)) & 1) == 0)) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(selected));
                if (found) mask |= (1 << next_id);
                next_id++;
            }
            probability[mask] = (probability[mask] + prob) % MOD;
            return;
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
            current.add(j);
            long new_prob = prob;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                    new_prob = (new_prob * probs[step][k]) % MOD;
                } else {
                    new_prob = (new_prob * ((MOD + 1 - probs[step][k]) % MOD)) % MOD;
                }
            }
            enumerate_subsets(step + 1, current, new_prob);
            current.remove(current.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(List<Integer> list) {
        int i = list.size() - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && list.get(i) >= list.get(i + 1)) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = list.size() - 1;
        while (list.get(j) <= list.get(i)) {
            j--;
        }
        Collections.swap(list, i, j);
        Collections.reverse(list.subList(i + 1, list.size()));
        return true;
    }

    static void enumerate_complement(int step, List<Integer> current, long prob) {
        if (step == N) {
            int next_id = 0, mask = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) != N - M) continue;
                List<Integer> selected = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) selected.add(i);
                }
                Collections.sort(selected);
                boolean found = false;
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int idx = 0; idx < N - M; idx++) {
                        if ((((current.get(idx) >> selected.get(idx)) & 1) == 0)) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(selected));
                if (found) mask |= (1 << next_id);
                next_id++;
            }
            probability2[mask] = (probability2[mask] + prob) % MOD;
            return;
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
            current.add(j);
            long new_prob = prob;
            for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                    new_prob = (new_prob * probs[step][k]) % MOD;
                } else {
                    new_prob = (new_prob * ((MOD + 1 - probs[step][k]) % MOD)) % MOD;
                }
            }
            enumerate_complement(step + 1, current, new_prob);
            current.remove(current.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                probs[i][j] = (long) val * mod_pow(100L, MOD - 2) % MOD;
                if (probs[i][j] < 0) probs[i][j] += MOD;
            }
        }

        if (N == 1) {
            System.out.println(probs[0][0]);
            return;
        }

        M = N / 2;
        List<Integer> temp = new ArrayList<>();
        enumerate_subsets(0, temp, 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            probability[i] %= MOD;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << 20); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    probability[j] = (probability[j] + probability[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        long total = probability[(1 << 20) - 1];

        temp.clear();
        enumerate_complement(M, temp, 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            probability2[i] %= MOD;
        }

        Arrays.fill(reverse_index, -1);
        int counter = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) != M) continue;
            reverse_index[i] = counter++;
        }

        Arrays.fill(reverse_index2, -1);
        counter = 0;
        Arrays.fill(corr, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) != N - M) continue;
            corr[counter] = reverse_index[((1 << N) - 1) ^ i];
            reverse_index2[i] = counter++;
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << counter); i++) {
            long cur = probability2[i];
            int mask = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < counter; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    // do nothing
                } else {
                    mask += (1 << corr[j]);
                }
            }
            result = (result + cur * ((total - probability[mask] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
